name: Madina Saduakasova
profileSummary: Madina Bakytzhankyzy Saduakasova is a Kazakh pop singer who rose to popularity with the song Махаббат Жалыны. She first gained nationwide recognition in Kazakhstan in 1999 upon becoming the Grand Prix winner of the national Zhas Kanat singing contest. In 2011 she was appointed "Honored Worker of Kazakhstan".
